Busty.reason: Metadata junk / non-artist ingestion artifact. Northern Dial's artist parser splits credits on ampersands, and the unresolved entries 'Busty' and 'The Bass' are the two fragments of the canonical Montreal band Busty & The Bass (Busty and the Bass), not separate recording artists. McGill identifies Busty & the Bass as the Montreal/McGill collective, and contemporary release coverage uses the same ampersand stylization.
